properties.site-address: Land to north of Market Place, Bedlington
properties.notes: Vacant site within the town centre offering chance for redevelopment. Permitted permission has been granted for a mixed-use scheme (18/01658/REM). As part of wider proposals, this includes provision of 4 dwellings. Development is yet to commence but is forecast for delivery within the next 5 years. The latest application revises the original outline application, which was for up to 12 homes (17/00444/OUT). The application covers a larger area than the SHLAA site, but is focused on mixed-use redevelopment of land within the town centre, and the housing is only a small element of the overall scheme. The permission is primarily for 7,720m2 of additional floorspace for non-residential use (6,800 net), with potential for a wide range of retail, commercial and leisure uses.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
